messages:
priya_people_ops: hey @ben, looping you in — we have a rehire offer that needs routing. Candidate Maya R, switching from contractor -> FT. Start plan: 6 weeks remote from the US (still on US payroll) then relocates to SG and switches payroll. Manager wants base 10% above band midpoint + $10k sign-on.

ben_manager: thx priya. what's the band for the role? senior ic band 4? that's over the band midpoint but within max?

priya_people_ops: it's Band 4 (senior ic). current band max is 180k, manager requesting 198k base. sign-on 10k one-time. that's > band max so we need comp-exception approval + finance check re: sign-on timing across payrolls. :eyes: 

liam_hiring_ops: FYI for routing: this will need hiring manager justification, approval from comp committee, and GC/benefits heads because of dual-payroll start. I'll queue the comp-exception form but need a short justification from Ben.

ben_manager: copy — justification: candidate has deep domain experience, 2x impact on last project, countered and accepted only at 198k. risk of losing them increases timeline for feature X by 8 weeks. also prefer the sign-on to cover relocation admin. short note below:

ben_manager: "Maya brings proprietary infra experience and will unblock key delivery; market data supports pay at 198k in the candidate's peer set. sign-on required to cover cross-border relocation admin and tax support."

zoe_finance: quick flags from finance: sign-on paid in US payroll before SG move = taxable in US; need to split paperwork if we pay any portion after relocation. Also, if base > band max we need approval for the ongoing run-rate. Can we make 5k upfront and 5k after payroll move? that reduces tax headaches.

emma_hrlegal: legal note: when moving payroll countries within first 3 months, we need employment agreement addendum + benefits enrollment dates clarified. Also need to confirm that benefits waiting period won't unintentionally exclude the employee when they move to SG; we prefer benefits eligibility to track payroll country start.

offer-bot: COMP-EXC FORM GENERATED -> https://hr.internal/forms/comp-exception?ref=3512345678 status: pending

priya_people_ops: next steps suggestion: 1) Ben post the justification in the comp-exception form (liam will send link). 2) Finance (zoe) propose split sign-on schedule (5k/5k). 3) Legal (emma) draft addendum and comment on benefits timing. 4) People Ops to route to comp committee once form is complete.

ben_manager: will fill form now. agree on split sign-on sounds fine to candidate. thanks all.

liam_hiring_ops: routing: I'll set comp-exception to "high priority" and add ccs: zoe_finance, emma_hrlegal, priya_people_ops. ETA for committee review: 48hrs once form complete. will update thread when submitted.

zoe_finance: noted, will pre-approve conditional sign-on split pending final payroll dates. will need candidate bank details for the second tranche after SG move.

emma_hrlegal: I'll prepare a short addendum template and confirm benefits eligibility impact. will upload doc to the form.

priya_people_ops: great — tagging for visibility: @people-ops please react when you've uploaded docs. :thumbsup:

ben_manager: done, form submitted: https://hr.internal/forms/comp-exception/3512345678

offer-bot: COMP-EXC SUBMITTED by ben_manager -> status: awaiting committee review

liam_hiring_ops: ack, moving to committee queue. will post back with outcome. thanks team.
